characters.interactions_notes: She is the storyteller; the man beside her is the silent, oblivious subject of her story. She never turns fully to look at him except a couple of passing glances — most of her attention (and the 'camera confession') is directed outward, as if talking to an unseen friend/audience, with him seated passively to her left. He does not react to her narration at all, reinforcing the joke that he is the 'low battery' one who doesn't even register her sarcasm. The power dynamic is entirely narrative: she holds the framing and the punchline, he is inert set-dressing.

He is spatially close (shoulder to shoulder in the same booth) but conversationally and emotionally distant — a literal illustration of 'low battery' disengagement while his partner performs all the emotional/verbal labor of the scene.
